textBox.richText: Matthew and Katherine - Air Force Academy, Cadet Chapel

For our wedding, my husband and I wanted to keep things easy and low key. We were looking for a chaplain who would both accept and respect who we were as people our and personal beliefs. We had talked with a few different chaplains, and quite frankly, were disappointed in what they had to say or how they wanted to run the ceremony. As soon as Chaplain Anderson and I started communicating, I told my husband, this has got to be our guy. I think that some people are simply made for certain things, and Paul has a gift with people. We could not have been happier.
